technical.summary: Mixed short-term momentum (RSI-9 bullish, Hull flip) conflicts with intermediate bearish structure (price below key EMAs/SMAs, Ichimoku below cloud); weak confluence and neutral sector backdrop make this a low-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MKC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 1 day presents elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (16/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional conviction and news data limits conviction; neutral congressional signal provides no directional confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (364.48), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent earnings binary event create severe risk environment for MKC trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip up, TEMA cross up, and supertrend bullish provide short-term momentum confirmation with price near support (80.25), while extreme fear sentiment (16/100) offers contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary within 24 hours, VIX crisis regime (364.48), price below all key moving averages (EMA-21, SMA-21), Ichimoku below cloud, no active strategy triggers, and zero fundamental/smart money support create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Hull flip and TEMA cross provide short-term momentum, but earnings binary within 24 hours and VIX crisis regime (364.48) create unacceptable risk-reward asymmetry for swing entry.
